---
name: Task for the factory
about: A change clear enough for an agent to build without guessing
---

## Problem

What is wrong or missing, and where (files, screens, commands).

## What to build

The change, in plain words. Name anything it must not touch.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A check that shows it works (a test that fails today and passes after).
- [ ] …
- [ ] Existing tests unchanged; the repo's checks pass.

## Out of scope

What this issue does not cover, so the agent does not do it.
